title: Minimum Possible Maximum Waiting Time
summary: Cars become eligible in order: the first at time zero, each later car when its predecessor starts fueling. Assign each eligible car to one of two dispensers with enough remaining fuel; it must wait for that dispenser if busy and start immediately once free. Demand determines both fuel consumed and service seconds. If neither dispenser can serve a car, processing stops. First maximize cars served, then minimize their largest eligibility-to-start wait. Return that wait, or -1 if none are served.
officialConstraints: 1..50 cars; demands1..20; exactly two fuel capacities, each1..50.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
